I grow enset on this small plot near my house, which my family has always depended on for food when the cereal harvests are thin. I do not put chemical fertilizer here because what little DAP and urea I can get from the cooperative I save for my larger maize and teff fields, but I do spread cow dung and compost from my homestead. The enset grows with the rains and needs no spraying; we plant local suckers and manage all the work ourselves without hiring any outside labor.
